text: 江苏雷利公告，预计2026年上半年归属于上市公司股东的净利润为9685.83万元～1.15亿元，比上年同期的1.86亿元下降38%～48%。预计扣除非经常性损益后的净利润为7392.67万元～9152.83万元，比上年同期下降48%～58%。业绩变动原因为人民币对美元汇率大幅升值致汇兑损失扩大，铜、铝、稀土等原材料价格高位致毛利率下降，以及新业务研发投入较高、汽车零部件业务产能爬坡等因素。
text_en: Jiangsu Leili announced that it expects net profit attributable to parent shareholders for the first half of 2026 to be RMB 96.8583 million to RMB 115 million, down 38% to 48% from RMB 186 million in the same period last year. Excluding non-recurring gains and losses, net profit is expected to be RMB 73.9267 million to RMB 91.5283 million, down 48% to 58% year-on-year. The reasons for the changes are the sharp appreciation of the RMB against the US dollar expanding exchange losses, high copper, aluminum, and rare earth raw material prices reducing gross margins, higher R&D investment in new businesses, and production capacity ramp-up in the auto parts business.
